# agentmemory REST API reference

Generated from `src/triggers/api.ts`. Do not edit the block below by hand; run `npm run skills:gen` after changing the registered endpoints.

The REST API is the primary surface. All paths are under `http://localhost:3111` (override with `--port`). When `AGENTMEMORY_SECRET` is set, send `Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMEMORY_SECRET`; localhost is otherwise open.

## Full extraction endpoints

These endpoints are for external, resumable full extraction orchestrators. They
are protected by the normal API auth middleware when `AGENTMEMORY_SECRET` is set.

### `GET /agentmemory/runtime-config`

Returns a redacted runtime summary. It does not expose tokens, provider keys, or
raw environment variables.

Response shape:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "runtime": {
    "summarizeChunkConcurrency": 1,
    "summarizeChunkSize": 400,
    "providerName": "pi-agent-sdk"
  }
}
```

### `POST /agentmemory/semantic-rollup`

Creates run-tagged semantic memories for either a session window or a corpus
window.

Window request:

```json
{
  "runId": "full-20260705-120000",
  "windowId": "w0001",
  "mark": "agentmemory-full-extraction",
  "kind": "window",
  "sessionIds": ["sess_a", "sess_b"]
}
```

Corpus request:

```json
{
  "runId": "full-20260705-120000",
  "windowId": "c001-l1",
  "mark": "agentmemory-full-extraction",
  "kind": "corpus",
  "semanticMemoryIds": ["sem_a", "sem_b"]
}
```

Successful responses include `inputHash`, `semanticMemoryIds`,
`semanticMemoryCharSizes`, and parsed `facts`. Repeated requests for the same
`runId`, `windowId`, `mark`, `kind`, and content `inputHash` return the existing
semantic memories with `reused: true` and do not call the provider again.

Failure responses include `success:false`, `error`, `runId`, `windowId`, `mark`,
`kind`, and `inputHash`. Expected orchestration errors include
`missing_sources`, `empty_facts`, `provider_error`, and `input_too_large`.

### `POST /agentmemory/extraction-runs/record`

Idempotently updates the internal extraction run index. The endpoint is a
sidecar index for external full extraction state, not a replacement for the
external state file.

Request:

```json
{
  "runId": "full-20260705-120000",
  "mark": "agentmemory-full-extraction",
  "status": "running",
  "summarySessionId": "sess_a",
  "lessonRunId": "lex_a",
  "semanticWindowId": "w0001",
  "corpusWindowId": "c001-l1"
}
```

`status` is optional and must be one of `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, or
`partial` when present. ID fields are optional; repeated values are de-duplicated.
